title: Core Awakening
tagline: Dismantle fallen Titans, salvage intact modules, rebuild your identity.
pitch: Control a surviving cyan Titan core in a modular salvage frame. Fight armored enemy constructs in a single-room tactical arena, targeted-dismantling their subsystems to claim rare drops. Decide instantly whether to Install, Secure, or Dismantle components to survive.
coreLoop: Evade telegraphed enemy attacks, precision-target specific subsystems (Weapon vs Core), and resolve quick 3-way salvage choices to rebuild power or bank score.

mechanics.name: Subsystem Precision Targeting
mechanics.description: Aim with mouse at highlighted enemy zones (Weapon vs Locomotion vs Core). Destroying weapons renders enemies safe but destroys weapon loot; defeating core preserves weapon loot.

mechanics.name: Telegraphed Tactical Evasion
mechanics.description: Enemy attacks broadcast bright orange hazard zones on the floor grid before firing. Spacebar dashes through danger zones with short invulnerability.

mechanics.name: 3-Way Salvage Decision
mechanics.description: Defeated modules drop a prompt (Keys 1/2/3 or Click): INSTALL for instant stat/visual buff, SECURE for major run points, or DISMANTLE to instantly repair Core integrity.

controls.keyboard: WASD / Arrows to move frame, Space to dash, 1/2/3 keys for Salvage choice
controls.mouse: Aim reticle at enemy subsystems, Left Click to fire primary laser

artDirection.mood: industrial cyberpunk, cyan core vs warm amber highlights
artDirection.backgroundFx: Pulsing power conduits along floor grid and ambient ember particle drift

audioDirection.musicMood: Heavy dark-synth pulse with rhythmic industrial bass

difficulty.start: Single heavy construct firing slow 120-degree telegraphed arc attacks.
difficulty.progression: Enemies spawn faster with overlapping telegraphs and shorter charge-up times.
difficulty.peak: Dual construct pressure forcing rapid dash positioning and quick subsystem priority choices.

winLose.win: Extract safely with 3 Secured modules or reach 2,500 points.

juice.screenShake: Heavy rumble on subsystem explosion and taking direct cannon hits
juice.particles: Cyan dash trails, orange spark bursts on armor impact, floating amber salvage glyphs
juice.hitStop: 80ms frame freeze on breaking an enemy subsystem
juice.flash: Red room flash on critical player damage, bright cyan flash upon installing module

scopeNotes: Strict single-room proof slice. No procedural dungeon generation, no persistent meta-shop, no complex inventory screens, no long cutscenes.
